My dear [Anna](/person/195)
I am sorry to say I cannot anyhow come on the 16th for it is our [School](/organisation/107) examination day, and it will not be over in time.

What shall we do without our Chairman who was a tower of strength on the right side

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
